name: Brockley Hall Hotel
suitableFor: Couples and groups wanting a hotel with restaurant
beachAccess: In Saltburn town; no distance stated
confirmedFeatures: Restaurant, brasserie, bar, afternoon tea, private dining, events
overview: A hotel in Saltburn with 30 rooms, each with its own bathroom, plus a restaurant, brasserie and bar open to non-residents. It is in the town itself, so the cliff lift and the walk down to the beach and pier are close at hand.
surfTripFit: A comfortable town base with food on site, an easy walk from the beach.
